run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence criterion loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets
create_make_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to one or more input frames
build_GTNLossFunction_forward: build a forward pass that scores target graphs against emissions using GTN forward scoring and intersection
test_GTNLossFunction_backward: test the backward pass to compute gradients for each example in parallel using GTN backward
review_GTNLossFunction: review the GTNLossFunction class that integrates GTN graphs as a custom PyTorch autograd loss function
